info.background_text:
Awakened One seeking peace, with no memory of his past.
Kayron himself does not know who he is or where he comes from. From the moment his memory begins, his life has been mired in conflict, so he longs for a place free of fighting and other burdens. Though he once saved Bria's life and became her benefactor, he doesn't believe it counts since he can't even remember doing it.
